verdict.rationale: Insomnia's documented AI features are limited to AI-assisted mock server generation from prompts, OpenAPI, or URLs, and AI commit message suggestions. Nothing in the evidence shows AI generating test cases or assertions for an endpoint. Mock generation is a different capability and earns no credit here, and the testing features (scripts, collection runner, Inso CLI) are manual rather than AI-generated.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI generate test cases or assertions for an endpoint from its spec or responses
